mapper.select: SELECT ct.commission_transaction_id, ct.settlement_month, ct.payment_stage, ct.amount, ct.status, ct.source_type, ta.transaction_attribution_id, ta.attributed_amount, ta.attribution_date, ta.inclusion_status_snapshot AS inclusion_status, ag.agent_id, ag.agent_name, ag.agent_code FROM fgc.transaction_attribution ta JOIN fgc.commission_transaction ct ON ct.commission_transaction_id = ta.commission_transaction_id LEFT JOIN fgc.agent ag ON ag.agent_id = ta.agent_id WHERE ta.contract_id = #{contractId} ORDER BY ct.commission_transaction_id, ta.attribution_seq
